title: The Cosmos in Operation: Elements, Generation, Speech, and Reflection
summary: The continuous operation of the cosmos in its regenerative work, ten teachings: the four elements bound to the Cross of Light in bodies and the cascade of strippings; the cloud and the three causes of storm by which falsity is exposed against the Virgin's likeness; the Living Soul as the second ploughed-field tilled by the two great luminaries; the three begettings of the flesh and the parthenos/enkrates doctrine at four registers; the twelve openings of the dragon and the victory by which the Virgin and Continent prevail; the reflected face in water as the diagram of Call and Answer; the five offspring the body brings forth from its food; the two sorrows of the luminaries; the word as five-minted coin shaped by five faculties before circulating between minds; and the buds in the elements destroyed by Hyle's shadow.
organizing_principle: The natural cosmos in its daily, generative, and discriminative operation — how every element, body, sound, reflection, and growth participates in the redemption. The section moves from elements and storms through generation and the body, into reflection and speech, ending with growth and shadow.
